info.title: Greek Developer - Graylog Query CLI
info.description: Read-only Graylog query CLI with named profiles and stored queries, for people and agents

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: glq: read-only Graylog queries with named profiles and stored queries.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --profile
options.description: Profile to use (default: $GLQ_PROFILE, then current_profile in config.json).

options.name: --insecure
options.description: Skip TLS certificate verification for this run. Prints a warning. [default: False]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Trace HTTP requests to stderr, with the Authorization header redacted. [default: False]

commands.name: search
commands.description: Search messages on the active profile.

options.name: --range
options.description: Relative range ending now: 30s, 15m, 2h, 1d, 1w (default: the profile's default_range).

options.name: --from
options.description: Absolute range start, ISO 8601. UTC unless it carries an offset or --tz is given.

options.name: --to
options.description: Absolute range end, ISO 8601.

options.name: --tz
options.description: Time zone for --from/--to values without an offset, e.g. Europe/Athens.

options.name: --stream
options.description: Stream name or ID. Repeatable (default: the profile's default_streams).

options.name: --fields
options.description: Comma-separated fields to return (default: the profile's default_fields).

options.name: --limit
options.description: Maximum messages to return (default: the profile's default_limit).

options.name: --sort
options.description: Sort as <field>:asc|desc (default: timestamp:desc).

options.name: --output
options.description: Output format: table, json, jsonl or csv (default: table on a terminal, jsonl otherwise).

options.name: --raw
options.description: Print the untransformed API response, for debugging. Still masked. [default: False]

options.name: --no-mask
options.description: Turn off masking of emails, phones and mask_fields. Card numbers stay masked. [default: False]

options.name: --yes
options.description: Confirm a large run against a production profile without a prompt. [default: False]

arguments.name: QUERY
arguments.description: Graylog/Lucene query, e.g. 'source:api AND http_status:>=500'. Use '*' for everything.

commands.name: profile
commands.description: Manage Graylog profiles - one per cluster or environment.

commands.name: add
commands.description: Add a profile.

options.name: --url
options.description: Graylog base URL, e.g. https://graylog.example.com

options.name: --production
options.description: Mark the target as production. [default: False]

options.name: --no-verify-tls
options.description: Store verify_tls = false. Every run then warns. [default: False]

options.name: --ca-bundle
options.description: Path to a custom CA bundle (PEM).

options.name: --timeout-seconds
options.description: Per-request timeout (default 30).

options.name: --token-command
options.description: Shell command that prints the token, e.g. a password-manager CLI.

options.name: --default-range
options.description: Relative range used when a search gives none (default 5m).

options.name: --default-stream
options.description: Stream name or ID used when a search gives none. Repeatable.

options.name: --default-limit
options.description: Result count used when a search gives none (default 100).

options.name: --default-fields
options.description: Comma-separated fields used when a search gives none.

options.name: --mask-field
options.description: Extra field name to mask on this profile. Repeatable.

options.name: --use
options.description: Make it the current profile. [default: False]

options.name: --force
options.description: Replace an existing profile of the same name. [default: False]

commands.name: list
commands.description: List profiles; * marks the current one.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output format: table, json, jsonl or csv (default: table on a terminal, jsonl otherwise).

commands.name: show
commands.description: Show a profile's settings and where its token comes from - never the token.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output format: table, json, jsonl or csv (default: table on a terminal, jsonl otherwise).

commands.name: use
commands.description: Make a profile the current one.

commands.name: remove
commands.description: Remove a profile, its token and its profile-only queries.

options.name: --yes
options.description: Skip the confirmation. [default: False]

commands.description: Check connectivity and authentication, and print the Graylog server version.

arguments.description: The profile to test (default: the active profile).

commands.description: Prompt for a profile's token, with hidden input, and store it in config.json.
